status: Sensitivity-extension design specified after inspection of the primary results; all cells and seeds are retained. No success-based seed or parameter selection.
objective: Methodological audit of ranking, calibration, decision rules and informative recording under distribution shift; no deployment claim.

probability_smoothing.prior: training class counts plus 0.5 per class; no test labels used

cv.objective: mean multiclass log loss after smoothing

selection_experiment.notes: Oracle uses additional independently generated validation labels only; final test never used for selection. Not a Bayes optimum.

decisions.development_threshold: max binary F2 on pooled out-of-fold development predictions; if no severe development case, retain fixed cost threshold 1/11
decisions.ties: deterministic random tie ordering with seed 991 per replicate; no label information

oracle.notes: Data-rich model reference is achievable performance, not upper bound. Finite-pattern Monte Carlo Bayes-accuracy interval separately accounts for estimation uncertainty and sparse cells.

ADEMP: The supplementary article reports the aim, crossed factors, methods, estimands, 30 seeds per cell and Monte Carlo precision; no 30-replicate power guarantee is claimed.
publication: No external posting or DOI creation performed. Author identities, contributions, funding, conflicts and license require factual confirmation.
